title: peer-contract v0.1 - Session Isolation
description: Session isolation envelope. Solves core problem #2 (session isolation) - SA1/SA2 are same agent A but different sessions, context must NOT leak. All cross-session interactions must be explicit.

context_scope.description: self = payload only references the dispatcher's own context. explicit_query = payload references other sessions, requires cross_session_query_ack=true.

payload_self_contained.description: HR4: true = payload contains all data needed (no external lookup required). false = payload has need_lookup references - only allowed if context_scope=explicit_query AND cross_session_query_ack=true.

cross_session_query_ack.description: Sender explicitly acknowledges this dispatch will trigger cross-session query (sessions_history, memory_search). HR5 audit log will record. Must be true if context_scope=explicit_query.

context_leak_protection.description: strict = recipient may NOT include dispatcher context in any reply. narrowed = recipient may include dispatcher context only in same dialog_key replies. open = no restriction. Default strict.

context_share_policy.description: Optional. If set, narrows which context the recipient may use.

allow_session_keys.description: Whitelist of session keys whose context recipient may reference. Empty array = no other sessions. Each key MUST include a non-empty context-id segment (e.g. agent:<id>:main:dashboard, agent:<id>:bus:dashboard, agent:<id>:work:card-x) — bare main/bus/work without context is rejected to avoid whole-agent over-grant.

deny_session_keys.description: Blacklist of session keys whose context recipient must NOT reference. Same context-id requirement as allow_session_keys.

allow_references.description: Which reference types are allowed: dispatch_id (point to specific dispatch), dialog_key (whole conversation), ac_chain (acceptance chain), context_summary (caller-provided digest).

ttl_seconds.description: Optional. How long recipient may cache/use this context. 0 = use once. Default 3600.

then.description: If payload needs external lookup, must be explicit_query + ack
